spec.name: 階層型解析の接続確認用・未製作案

evidence.bottle_mass: Fixed 48 g shell scenario shared by GA and DE; unweighed

phase_diagnostics.scope: sampled analytic CP/CG; ideal continuous two-axis guide, no friction or clearance

beam.load_scope: CFD concurrent fin force envelope; beam load shape remains assumed

structure.load_scope: CFD Fn and both root moments at concurrent extrema; reconstructed pressure, not local traction; tangential load omitted

barbalat.rule: finite observed decay is not evidence of infinite-horizon uniform continuity

limitations: attachment and constitutive properties are assumptions
CFD/FEM envelopes omit printed clip/slot detail

mapping.scope: nonlinear solid fin, compliant root and follower pressure
mapping.normal_load_scope: CFD force and two root moments; signed reconstructed pressure; tangential load omitted

grid_change_driver.scope: Maximum over all tabulated conditions; separate from trajectory propagation

numerical_details.geometry_resolution_note: Interpolated walls place specified surfaces between nodes; spacing ratios alone do not establish near-wall/thin-fin flow resolution or model validity

limitations: Two selected finalists; not independent estimates of general optimizer performance
Grid/time/parameter sensitivity is not experimental validation
Constitutive and mount scenarios are unmeasured; no hardware qualification
One-way CFD load transfer to FEM; deformed geometry is not fed back into CFD/flight
Point-mass equipment/payload placement omits volumetric packaging checks
FEM stress is reported without qualified material strength allowables
Local linear stability does not prove full-flight nonlinear stability
execution_cost_scope: Sum of simultaneous candidate executions including failed domain attempts and resumed-parent time; not wall time or training/diagnostic/development cost
